Analysis Visit (N)

Derivation: ADY = ADT - TRTSDT + 1, if ADT>=TRTSDT. ADY = ADT - TRTSDT, if ADT<TRTSDT.

Label: Analysis Record Flag 01
Derivation: Set ANL01FL=Y based on SAP Page 10 analysis windows.

Label: Derivation Type
Derivation: Value: LOCF denotes that the LOCF imputation method was used to impute the value for the given parameter and analysis visit.

Label: Analysis Window Valid Relative Range
Derivation: Window range, specified in the SAP.

Label: Analysis Window Target
Derivation: Target day within the window, specified in the SAP.

Label: Analysis Window Diff from Target
Derivation: Absolute difference between AWTARGET and ADY

Label: Analysis Window Beginning Timepoint
Derivation: Start day of the window, specified in the SAP.

Label: Analysis Window Ending Timepoint
Derivation: End day of the window, specified in the SAP.
